Our shop sells cut flowers, pot plants, garden furniture and accessories - basically everything a garden centre would sell other than the actual outdoor plants, soil, manure etc.

The couple said that they bought the chairs about 20 years ago (at least they didn't lie), had put the chairs out the side of their house and then forgot that they were there. They wanted either free replacements for the cushions or money back for the chairs if we couldn't find the right sized cushions. They thought that this was perfectly reasonable as the chairs had never been used!

They were both very polite (unusual for people wanting free stuff) but were really put out that I wouldn't give them either cushions or their money back. I offered to sell them some outdoor furniture cleaner and help taking the chairs back to their car but they weren't interested. When I went out the front of the shop about 15 minutes later I noticed that they had left the chairs just to the side of our furniture display. I kept them out the back for the rest of the day then chucked them.
